выбираться.gloss: to run for office; to get out

meanings.en: to run for office, to stand for election
meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'бираться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to run for office; to get out', paired with 'выбраться'.

meanings.en: to get out, to make one's way out

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ложный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('complicated, difficult').
